sentences.text: Suvayan Sharmila Mondal @ Sarmila ... vs Sushanta Mandal &

Suvayan Sharmila Mondal @ Sarmila Mandal
 Vs.
The present revisional application of the year 2019 was last heard on 22.07.2021.

The present revision of the years 2019 has been preferred praying for quashing of the proceeding being G. R. No. 5015/19 arising out of Joynagar Police Station Case No. 360 of 2019 dated 24.07.2019 under Sections 498A/307/34 of the IPC.
As none appears for the petitioner on repeated calls, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected applications, if any, stand disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance and to proceed with the trial expeditiously, if not disposed of, in accordance with law.
(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
